detail.requirements:
• 5–8+ years of experience in analytics, data science, or commercial insights
• Strong experience in pharma/healthcare or related industries
• Proven track record delivering SFE or commercial analytics solutions
• Hands-on experience with data science / AI methods (e.g., ML, optimization, predictive analytics)
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
detail.main_tasks:
• Lead end-to-end delivery of insight generation initiatives across North Asia (Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong) markets
• Own high-priority projects such as resource optimization, advanced analytics in Segmentation & Targeting
• Translate business problems into advanced analytics solutions and actionable recommendations
• Drive adoption of AI-powered insight generation frameworks and business recommendation
• Build scalable analytics solutions to improve efficiency and decision speed
• Identify and prioritize high-impact use cases across SFE and commercial domains
• Act as the primary point of contact for North Asia stakeholders
• Partner with cross-functional teams (CE, BU, IT, regional and local teams)
• Ensure alignment between local market needs and regional strategy
• Communicate insights clearly to senior stakeholders to drive decision and actions
• Influence decision-making through methodology design, data storytelling and business impact articulation
• Build strong relationships to sustain long-term engagement
detail.intro: At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity.
detail.preferred_points:
• Korean language proficiency is highly preferred
• Experience in North Asia markets and TA knowledge (Oncology, Immunology)
• Familiarity with GenAI / automation-driven analytics workflows
• Experience leading regional or cross-market initiatives

job.position: Manager, North Asia, Insight Generation (AI & Analytics)
